{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

# Print number of unique patients and total rows
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Unique patients: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(duplicate_patients)}")

# Show the highest sample_seq for each patient
max_sample_seq = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Show how many patients have multiple sample_seq
print(f"Patients with multiple sample_seq: {sum(max_sample_seq > 1)}")

# Confirm the data dictionary instruction: keep the highest sample_seq row per patient
data_deduped = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

print(f"After deduping (keeping highest sample_seq per patient): {len(data_deduped)} rows")"}
